module_title: The Schedules - Oaths, Tribal Areas, and Federal Lists
introduction: At this level, we dive into the specific exceptions in the oath schedule, the critical difference between the 5th and 6th schedules regarding tribal administration, and the distribution of power in the 7th schedule.

core_concepts.title: Third Schedule (Oaths)
core_concepts.description: Contains the forms of oaths for Union Ministers, MPs, Supreme/High Court Judges, and the CAG. Exception: The oaths of the President (Art 60), Vice-President (Art 69), and Governor (Art 159) are NOT in the 3rd Schedule; they have specific articles.

core_concepts.title: Fifth Schedule (5th)
core_concepts.description: Deals with the administration and control of 'Scheduled Areas' and 'Scheduled Tribes' in any state EXCEPT the four North-Eastern states mentioned in the 6th Schedule.

core_concepts.title: Sixth Schedule (6th)
core_concepts.description: Deals specifically with the administration of 'Tribal Areas' in only four North-Eastern states: Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram. It provides for the creation of Autonomous District Councils (ADCs).

core_concepts.title: Seventh Schedule (7th - Federal Lists)
core_concepts.description: Divides powers between the Union and States via 3 lists: Union List (originally 97, now 100 subjects), State List (originally 66, now 61 subjects), and Concurrent List (originally 47, now 52 subjects).

core_concepts.title: 8th Schedule Amendments
core_concepts.description: 21st Amendment added Sindhi. 71st Amendment added Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali. 92nd Amendment added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, Santhali.

important_entities.name: Concurrent List
important_entities.significance: Both Parliament and State Legislatures can make laws on subjects in this list. However, in case of a conflict, the Central law prevails.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Manipur is NOT in the 6th Schedule
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: This is the most common UPSC/State PCS trap. The 6th schedule covers Mizoram and Meghalaya, but NOT Manipur.
Schedule 2 lists salaries for the President, Governors, Speakers, Judges, and CAG. It does NOT explicitly list the salaries of the Prime Minister, Chief Ministers, or other Ministers.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: A-Assam, M-Meghalaya, T-Tripura, M-Mizoram. (Remember: 'M' does not stand for Manipur).

exam_strategy_tips: Always remember the 3 exceptions to the 3rd Schedule (President, VP, Governor).
Memorize the 5 subjects shifted from the State List to the Concurrent List by the 42nd Amendment (1976), especially 'Education' and 'Forests'.
